productionWaves.purpose: Audit current terrain, creature atlas, shell, effects, and existing open asset PRs; lock naming, source profiles, and derivative schemas.
Prove one coherent product style across basic terrain, props, player art, new monsters, UI, scenes, and effects before mass production.
Add biome variation, tactical props, six-monster battle roster, objective presentation, and complete battle states.
Add reusable campaign scenes, player/NPC presentation, exploration sprites, maps, cards, and encounter transitions.
Produce only the additional assets needed by the first selected plot families after the common pack works.

rules: No recent plot, NPC list, or deterministic fixture controls the product-wide production order.
Human trainers are not monster species.
The registry includes both prepared current assets and future required families; priority controls sequence, not omission.
Every accepted source retains provenance, review notes, derivative recipe, and screenshot evidence.
Source masters and runtime derivatives remain separate.
Existing assets are audited before duplicate production.
Scenes and props are reusable layers rather than incident-specific screenshots.
Gameplay geometry and state remain authoritative in code, never in asset pixels.
Generated sources are rejected or repaired when they fail runtime-size readability, alpha, continuity, or originality.
